title: System contract
description: A machine-checkable statement that a particular output must not change, and what it costs if it does. The authority is scripts/contracts.sh validate, which also checks that the protected fields still exist in the code — something no schema can do.

name.description: Stable identifier; should match the filename.

status.description: A proposed contract grants no auto-apply permission and must pair with policy.autoApply = never.

why.description: The business consequence of breaking this, in plain language. Mandatory: a contract without a stated consequence is a guess, and nobody can review a guess.

paths.description: Repo-relative globs. * within a segment, ** across segments, **/ zero or more directories.

field.description: Dotted path as the consumer sees it.

locator.description: File where the field is declared; the drift check greps it.

class.description: Selects the assertion: exact equality / band plus mean drift over N samples / reported but never failing.

assertOn.description: shape is for a field whose value legitimately varies every call but whose format is parsed elsewhere.

shape.description: Required when assertOn is shape. A regex or named format.

tolerance.description: Required when class is bounded; forbidden when class is deterministic.

bandSource.description: The name of a guardrail that defines the band in code. Preferred over restating it here.

meanDriftPct.description: Catches a systematic shift that stays inside the band.

tolerant.description: Fields explicitly allowed to drift, so nobody has to guess.

guardrails.description: In-code protections this contract asserts still exist. A band defined in code stays the single source of truth; the contract asserts nobody deleted it.

asserts.description: What this code guarantees, in plain language. Whoever hits the failure needs to know what they just lost.

externalBoundary.description: Fields whose real logic lives behind a network call or in another service. A contract that cannot be verified must declare that rather than imply coverage.

compensating.description: The out-of-band check that does cover it, and how stale it may get.

sampler.description: How to produce samples for bounded fields. contracts.sh never runs this; CI does.

autoApply.description: never means a change touching this contract is never applied unattended, whatever its class. It does not block the work; it blocks the work happening silently.

onDriftUnresolved.description: An unresolved field means the contracts no longer describe the code, so the default blocks the project.
